race.description: Village Roadshow Theme Parks Mdn Plate
race.comment: FIVE OF US (7) is unlucky to still be a maiden hitting the frame at her past five outings and strikes a very winnable contest here. Has placed three of four around this circuit and hoop Turner sticks following the last couple of placings. Rates the testing material. SHIP HAPPENS (4) has had a few chances but has been right there in recent efforts and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Looms as the main danger. MOANA NUI (2) placed over this staying test last time out and will be rock-hard fit for this. Top-three credentials. DISGRUNTLED (6) brings NSW formlines to the table and any market support must be noted. KALAMIA KING (1) next in line.
